cashbackCalculation.answer: You earn the specified cashback amount for each eligible completed and paid order, and all of the money collected will be deposited daily to the wallet according to the campaign Terms & Conditions.
cashbackCalculation.question: How is cashback calculated?

howItWorks.answer: Complete eligible orders during the campaign period to earn a free year subscription and / or cashback. The more eligible orders you complete, the more rewards you earn.
howItWorks.question: How does the National Day campaign work?

howToEarnRewards.answer: Complete eligible orders during the campaign period to earn the free year subscription and / or cashback based on the campaign rules.
howToEarnRewards.question: How do I earn rewards?

orderEligibility.answer: Only eligible orders that meet the campaign Terms & Conditions will be counted.
orderEligibility.question: Are all orders eligible?

trackProgress.answer: You can track your completed orders, progress, and earned cashback from the campaign page or your dashboard.
trackProgress.question: Where can I track my progress and rewards?

unlockNextMilestone.answer: Complete the required number of eligible orders to automatically unlock the next milestone and its rewards.
unlockNextMilestone.question: How do I unlock the next milestone?

whenDoesCampaignEnd.answer: The campaign ends at the end of the promotional period. Make sure to complete your eligible orders before the campaign ends.
whenDoesCampaignEnd.question: When does the campaign end?
